comment:
* An interface that can receive Update operations that are applied to a list. *

* This class can be used together with DiffUtil to detect changes between two lists.

methods.name: void onInserted(int position, int count)
methods.comment:
* Called when {@code count} number of items are inserted at the given position.
     *
     * @param position The position of the new item.
     * @param count    The number of items that have been added.

methods.name: void onRemoved(int position, int count)
methods.comment:
* Called when {@code count} number of items are removed from the given position.
     *
     * @param position The position of the item which has been removed.
     * @param count    The number of items which have been removed.

methods.name: void onMoved(int fromPosition, int toPosition)
methods.comment:
* Called when an item changes its position in the list.
     *
     * @param fromPosition The previous position of the item before the move.
     * @param toPosition   The new position of the item.

methods.name: void onChanged(int position, int count, @Nullable Object payload)
methods.comment:
* Called when {@code count} number of items are updated at the given position.
     *
     * @param position The position of the item which has been updated.
     * @param count    The number of items which has changed.
     * @param payload  The payload for the changed items.

methodNames: void onChanged(int position, int count, @Nullable Object payload)
